text:
I might push it to Wednesday this week to take some pressure off of us.  Haven't had time to fill in the blanks this week.  I think you'll have to go directly to the fencing-api to see if you can get the latest results.  

I'm torn about what to do...  many elite kids at Medeo but they honestly did terrible.  Maybe the focus should be that they started their competitive paths?  For many it's their first tournament.  For others it's like their second?  But they got whooped badly.

Even Remy's results wasn't that great.  He could have done much better.  

Still...  these are kids and I want to be supportive.  

I'm open to ideas here.
changes: Target publish day set to Wednesday, Nov. 11 (tentative; Frank hasn't submitted v1).
Sunday's results were pulled from FencingTracker event pages and, later, Frank's official Medeo CSVs. v1's other open questions stay open.
